<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template for a Friedel‑Crafts acylation, I will search the template catalog using a typical product of this reaction, acetophenone (c1ccccc1C(=O)C). In the forward reaction a halide (C–Cl) is broken, and a new C–C bond is formed between the aromatic carbon and the carbonyl carbon. Therefore I will search for templates that break a halide functional group and form a C–C bond.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccccc1C(=O)C",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"]
}</action_input>
